spec.title: Shared Content Evaluation Rules v2
spec.description: Single source of truth for content evaluation configuration shared between Flutter and Browser platforms. v2 introduces gates, anchors, deterministic checks, and enhanced result contract.

scoring.formula: sum((dimensionScore / dimensionMaxScore) * dimensionWeight), rounded to nearest integer

dimensions.name: Hook Strength
dimensions.description: Opening hook strength and engagement potential in the first 3 seconds

anchors.10: Opens on a specific, visual, unresolved moment from the story (action/choice/consequence). Under 90 chars. Ends with a question or cliffhanger that demands the next frame.
anchors.6: Opens on the story topic but is generic, descriptive, or over 100 chars. Has a question but lacks a concrete visual hook.
anchors.2: Missing, purely thematic, or a title-style label. No action, no question, no curiosity loop.

dimensions.name: Relatability & Audience Fit
dimensions.description: How relatable the problem/setting is to parents of children aged 1-4; everyday family routines

anchors.10: Problem is a specific, named everyday routine (mealtime, bedtime, leaving house, screen time, sharing, potty, transition). Setting is a recognizable home/park/school location. Language reflects parent vocabulary.
anchors.6: Problem is recognizably toddler-relevant but vague ("tantrum", "not listening"). Setting is generic. Some parent-facing language.
anchors.2: Abstract, adult-centric, or fantasy problem. No identifiable routine. Setting is vague or missing. No parent-facing hooks.

dimensions.name: Payoff & Retention
dimensions.description: Narrative arc completeness: problem → twist → resolution → moral/ending. Resolution and moral are optional; an unresolved ending can be a deliberate payoff.

anchors.10: Clear problem, twist, and resolution. Moral/ending beat lands emotionally or practically. Payoff feels earned. Retention hooks (callback, reveal, emotion) present.
anchors.6: Problem and twist present. Resolution exists but moral/ending is thin or missing. Some retention element.
anchors.2: Missing storyDetail or only problem stated. No twist, no resolution, no payoff structure.

dimensions.name: Hinglish Naturalness
dimensions.description: Natural use of Hinglish in dialogue and on-screen text; adults speak natural Hindi, children use age-appropriate Hinglish

anchors.10: Dialogue feels like real family speech. Adults use natural Hindi phrases. Children (1-4) use age-appropriate Hinglish (single words, simple phrases). Code-switching is organic.
anchors.6: Some Hinglish present but feels scripted or uneven. Adult/child voice not clearly differentiated. Occasional unnatural phrasing.
anchors.2: Pure English or pure Hindi with no mixing. Or forced/inauthentic Hinglish. No dialogue at all.

dimensions.name: Visual Feasibility
dimensions.description: How feasible the content is to visualize and produce as a 15-30s Reel

anchors.10: Clear setting, 1-3 characters, 3-5 distinct beats, simple props, single location. Fits 15-30s with breathing room. On-screen text beats ≤ 7, well-paced.
anchors.6: Multiple locations, >3 characters, complex action, or >7 text beats. Produceable but tight or ambitious.
anchors.2: Crowd scenes, many location changes, abstract concepts hard to show, >10 text beats, or duration unclear/outside 15-30s.

dimensions.name: Sound-Off Readability
dimensions.description: Content understandable without audio (captions, overlay text, visual storytelling)

anchors.10: Story is clear from visuals + on-screen text alone. Key beats have text overlays. Caption summarizes the takeaway. Pinned comment adds context.
anchors.6: Visuals convey main action but 1-2 beats rely on dialogue. Caption present. Pinned comment missing or generic.
anchors.2: Story incomprehensible without audio. No on-screen text. Caption missing or irrelevant.

dimensions.name: Share/Save Trigger
dimensions.description: Likelihood of shares and saves: actionable tip, relatable debate, emotional payoff, or visual cheat-sheet

anchors.10: Clear save trigger: 3-step visual rule, script parents can use, or "try this tonight" action. Or strong emotional/shareable moment ("send this to your husband").
anchors.6: Some shareable element (question, tip) but not formatted for saves. Emotional beat present but not highlighted.
anchors.2: No clear save/share trigger. Generic engagement question only ("what do you think?").

dimensions.name: Caption & Comment Package
dimensions.description: Caption quality (first-line hook, hashtags 3-5, CTA) and pinned comment (specific question/tip, not generic)

anchors.10: Caption: first line is a hook/debate question, 3-5 relevant hashtags, clear CTA. Pinned comment: specific, non-generic question or actionable tip tied to the story.
anchors.6: Caption has hashtags and CTA but first line is descriptive. Pinned comment present but generic or template-like.
anchors.2: Caption missing, no hashtags, or >5 hashtags. Pinned comment missing, generic template, or copied from another idea.

dimensions.name: Originality
dimensions.description: Concept freshness vs. duplicate/near-duplicate ideas in the library

anchors.10: Unique problem/angle not seen in library. Fresh twist on a routine. No near-duplicate (title+problem+story cosine < 0.8).
anchors.6: Similar to existing idea but distinct problem/twist/character. Cosine similarity 0.5-0.8.
anchors.2: Near-duplicate of existing idea (cosine > 0.8). Same problem, same beat structure, only minor wording changes.

dimensions.name: Audio Hook
dimensions.description: First 3 seconds of audio: dialogue, sound effect, or music cue that grabs attention

anchors.10: Opening audio is a distinct sound effect, character exclamation, or dialogue line that matches the visual hook. Creates immediate curiosity.
anchors.6: Audio present (dialogue/music) but generic or not synced to the visual hook moment.
anchors.2: No audio described. Silent opening. Or generic background music only.

gates.name: Age Appropriateness
gates.description: Content is suitable for children aged 1-4 (the characters shown) and parents watching. No scary, sexual, violent, or developmentally inappropriate content.

gates.name: Character Consistency
gates.description: Only approved characters (Ria, Rio, Cuty, Mumma, Papa, Daadi, Robot, Teacher) are used. Names spelled correctly. Pronouns consistent per character across all fields.

gates.name: Brand & Safety
gates.description: No brand names (Britannia, Parle-G, Amul, Maggi, Cadbury, etc.) or IP-style terms (Pixar, Disney, Peppa Pig, etc.) in readyPrompt, caption, pinnedComment, storyDetail. No unsafe language depicting harm to children as positive.

gates.name: Format Fit
gates.description: The idea fits its declared postFormat (Reel, Carousel, Story). Reels need 15-30s narrative. Carousels need 5-7 slides. Stories need interactive element.

verdicts.label: Needs Minor Fixes
verdicts.description: Content needs minor improvements before publishing

criticalCap.condition: critical findings count > 0 AND raw score > capThreshold
criticalCap.description: When critical findings exist, the final score is capped at 59 and the verdict is forced to Needs Major Rewrite, regardless of the raw weighted score.

additionalCaps.description: If a critical-severity gate fails, cap score at 59 and force Needs Major Rewrite verdict.

additionalCaps.condition: any gate failed with severityOnFail === 'major' AND rawScore > 79
additionalCaps.description: If a major-severity gate fails and raw score would be Ready to Post, cap at 79 (Needs Minor Fixes).

checks.name: Placeholder Text Detection
checks.description: Detects placeholder patterns like X{4,}, TODO, lorem, Archived in readyPrompt, caption, pinnedComment, storyDetail

checks.name: Missing Required Fields
checks.description: Flags empty readyPrompt, caption, or pinnedComment

checks.name: Generic Pinned Comment
checks.description: Compares pinnedComment against genericPinnedComments.json templates using normalized substring/fuzzy match

checks.name: Pinned Comment Story Mismatch
checks.description: Tokenizes pinnedComment and story fields; flags if keyword overlap with title/problem/storyDetail is below threshold (default 1 shared meaningful keyword)

checks.name: Caption Story Mismatch
checks.description: Tokenizes caption and story fields; flags if keyword overlap with title/problem/storyDetail is below 15% threshold

checks.name: Opening Cast Mismatch
checks.description: Detects capitalized character-like words or relationship words (Uncle, Aunty) in opening that are not in defaultCast or storyDetail

checks.name: Unapproved Character Name
checks.description: Flags names outside approved list; checks pronoun consistency (he/she) for same character across fields

checks.name: Brand Name Detection
checks.description: Scans readyPrompt, caption, pinnedComment, storyDetail against brandAndIpBlocklist.json

checks.name: Text Beat Density
checks.description: Parses On-Screen Text: lines with [a-b]s timestamps; flags >7 beats or >1 beat per 2.5s

checks.name: Duration Check
checks.description: Infers duration from last timestamp; flags outside 15-30s

checks.name: Repeated End Slate
checks.description: Flags if final overlay text appears in >50% of library

checks.name: Duplicate Similarity
checks.description: Online: embedding cosine similarity >0.8. Offline: TF-IDF cosine on title+problem+storyDetail with configurable threshold. Returns duplicateOf ids.

checks.name: Seasonality
checks.description: Uses festivalCalendar.json keywords; if dates filled and date passed, flags; if empty, only tags with seasonTag

checks.name: Typo Check
checks.description: Lightweight check on on-screen text/dialogue; small allow-list for valid Hinglish words

calibration.notes: Run scripts/calibrate.js against content_ideas.json to verify distributions.

performanceFeedback.description: Future: correlate evaluation scores with actual post performance to refine weights/anchors.

audience.notes: Characters in the content (Ria, Rio, Cuty) are depicted as children aged 1-4. Adults (Mumma, Papa, Daadi, Teacher) are caregivers. Language rules: adults speak natural Hindi; children use age-appropriate Hinglish.

severities.label: Critical
severities.description: Safety violation or severe issue that must be fixed

severities.label: Major
severities.description: Significant issue that should be addressed

fields.name: ideaId
fields.description: Unique identifier of the evaluated idea

fields.name: dimensionScores
fields.description: Array of dimension score objects, one per configured dimension

fields.name: gateResults
fields.description: Array of gate results (pass/fail) with gate id, name, passed, severityOnFail, detail

fields.name: overallScore
fields.description: Final weighted score after all caps (0-100)

fields.name: rawScore
fields.description: Raw weighted score before any caps (0-100)

fields.name: scoreCapped
fields.description: Whether the score was capped due to critical findings or gate failures

fields.name: capsApplied
fields.description: Array of cap ids that were applied (e.g., ['criticalCap', 'gateFailureCap'])

fields.name: verdict
fields.description: Overall verdict label

fields.name: criticalFindings
fields.description: Array of critical severity findings

fields.name: majorFindings
fields.description: Array of major severity findings

fields.name: minorFindings
fields.description: Array of minor severity findings

fields.name: suggestions
fields.description: Array of improvement suggestions

fields.name: fixesToReach10
fields.description: Ordered fixes to reach 100: each has fix, dimensionId, estimatedGain (points)

fields.name: potentialScore
fields.description: Score if all fixesToReach10 are applied (max 100)

fields.name: rewrittenHook
fields.description: Suggested first-3-second hook rewrite

fields.name: duplicateOf
fields.description: Array of idea ids that are near-duplicates (cosine > threshold)

fields.name: recommendedFormat
fields.description: reel | carousel | story | merge-into-series

fields.name: seasonTag
fields.description: Festival/season tag from festivalCalendar.json if keywords matched

fields.name: deterministicChecks
fields.description: Results of all deterministic checks

fields.name: confidence
fields.description: high | medium | low (online: based on median spread; offline: always low)

fields.name: evaluationMode
fields.description: offline or online

fields.name: evaluatedAt
fields.description: ISO 8601 timestamp

fields.name: evaluationVersion
fields.description: Engine version string, set to 2.0.0

conflicts.description: Known differences between Flutter and Browser evaluation systems that were NOT resolved in this shared specification. Flutter files remain untouched.

flutterQualityChecker.dimensions: None - rules are not grouped into weighted dimensions
flutterQualityChecker.status: Flutter file untouched. Future migration will map these rules to shared dimensions.

flutterQualityGate.status: Flutter file untouched. Separate system from the shared browser specification.

browser.criticalCap: Score capped at 59 if critical findings exist and raw score > 59; additional caps for gate failures
browser.status: Browser engine updated to use this v2 shared specification.

unresolved: Flutter QualityChecker rules (42 code-based rules) cannot be expressed as JSON configuration - they remain in Dart code.
Flutter QualityGate PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN model differs from Browser's weighted scoring model - no common verdict schema defined.
Flutter reach dimensions (reach_hook_strength, etc.) are warn-only heuristics, not scored dimensions.
Browser online evaluation uses Gemini API; Flutter has no equivalent online evaluation in the quality gate.

v2 dimension IDs changed: relatability->relatabilityAudienceFit, storyStructure->payoffRetention, engagementPotential split into shareSaveTrigger + captionCommentPackage, new: originality, audioHook. Gates replace ageAppropriateness, characterConsistency, brandAndSafety as scored dimensions.
